subject: Hindi
description: A simple Hindi lesson with a slow voice flow and clear Hinglish support.

lines.text: Hamara gaon har subah nayi roshni ke saath jagta hai.
lines.explanation: Gaon subah fresh aur active feel karta hai.

lines.text: Khet, ped aur pakshiyon ki awaaz milkar sundar mahaul banati hai.
lines.explanation: Nature ki awaaz milkar achha atmosphere banati hai.

lines.text: Bachche school jaate hue khushi se baat karte hain.
lines.explanation: Bachche school jaate waqt khushi se baat karte hain.

lines.text: Mehnat aur safai se har gaon aur achha ban sakta hai.
lines.explanation: Mehnat aur safai se gaon aur better ban sakta hai.
